name: フレーム間ブレンド解析
algorithm: Inter-Frame Blend — ピクセルレベル空間分析
mechanism:
This method detects inter-frame blending artifacts for video deepfake detection:

1. **FrameBlend検出**: The method identifies frames that appear to be blends of adjacent frames — visible as ghosting, double-exposure effects, or unnatural motion blur. Frame blending can result from frame rate conversion in the deepfake pipeline or temporal smoothing applied to reduce generation flicker.

2. **動きBlur分析**: Natural motion blur follows object motion trajectories with blur direction and magnitude consistent with the object's velocity. The method analyzes blur characteristics — artificially blended frames show non-directional or multi-directional blur inconsistent with any single motion trajectory.

3. **AlphaブレンディングResidual検出**: Frame blending typically uses alpha compositing: I_blend = α·I_t + (1−α)·I_{t+1}. This creates characteristic intermediate pixel values detectable via distribution analysis. The method detects frames with bimodal pixel value distributions indicating blend composition.

4. **時間的Derivative分析**: The temporal derivative (frame difference) signal is analyzed. Natural video shows smooth temporal derivatives with abrupt changes only at scene cuts. Blended frames produce characteristic low-derivative frames (blending reduces temporal contrast) surrounded by normal-derivative frames.

5. **Blendパターンスコアリング**: The temporal pattern of detected blend artifacts is analyzed. Periodic blending (every N frames) indicates frame rate conversion. Random blending may indicate temporal smoothing to cover generation artifacts. The pattern and frequency of blending provide forensic clues about the manipulation pipeline used.
parameters:
分析タイプ: ピクセル
メディア: 動画
入力: Video frames extracted at key intervals
出力: 信頼度スコア (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 中〜高 — 70-88% 単独精度. Most effective when combined with other 動画 forensic methods. Performance depends on 動画 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 動画 through inter-frame blend analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 動画 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 動画 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 動画 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 動画 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 動画
